<div class="product-short-description">
<p>Hot Water Bag For Pain Relief. Electric Hot Water Bag used to provide warmth, typically whilst in bed, but also for the application of heat to a specific part of the body.</p>
<p>It is a high-quality reliever from aches in cold climatic conditions. Gives relief from pain and makes you feel comfortable.</p>
<p>Features Run on Electricity no hassles of heating water on gas or heaters. Made of Soft Material. Saves the hassles of changing water like in an ordinary bag. Keeps the water warm for 2-5hrs A very useful product for the winters You can keep it inside the quilt to heat up the quilt or use on low temperature for massaging body parts</p>
